Über Rivia

Rivia ist ein Technologieunternehmen, das eine Datenplattform entwickelt, die die Zukunft der klinischen Studienanalyse prägt. Rivia wurde aus der Überzeugung heraus gegründet, dass sich neue Medikamente mit einem Bruchteil des heutigen Kapitals erfolgreicher auf den Markt bringen lassen.

Biotech-Unternehmen sind die wichtigste Quelle therapeutischer Innovationen. Ihre klinische Entwicklung wird jedoch immer wieder durch fragmentierte Daten und veraltete Werkzeuge ausgebremst. Rivia führt klinische Studiendaten in großem Maßstab zusammen. Das Herzstück ist eine wiederverwendbare intelligente Datenplattform mit Hunderten von Konfigurationen und studienspezifischen Logiken, die unabhängig von der Struktur der Quelldaten funktioniert. Diese vertikal integrierte Kombination aus Datenplattform, Workflows und KI-Agenten schafft einen entscheidenden Vorteil bei der Durchführung klinischer Studien.

In den vergangenen zwei Jahren haben Biotech-Unternehmen aus Europa und den USA, die mit Rivia weltweit klinische Studien durchführen, messbare Ergebnisse erzielt: von einem früheren Verständnis des therapeutischen Potenzials bis hin zu deutlich effizienteren Studienabläufen. Im März 2026 nahm Rivia in einer Series-A-Finanzierungsrunde 15 Millionen US-Dollar auf, angeführt von Earlybird Venture Capital.

Rivia will zur Standardinfrastruktur für die moderne Arzneimittelentwicklung werden und die Durchführung klinischer Studien von Anfang bis Ende grundlegend verändern.

Die Rolle

Als Senior Talent & People Partner bist du die erste Verstärkung im People-Team von Rivia. Gemeinsam mit der Leitung des People-Bereichs baust du die Funktion von Grund auf auf und entwickelst sie weiter. Du verantwortest den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess und wächst zugleich in weitere People-Themen hinein: Mitarbeitererfahrung, Entwicklung, Performance, Unternehmenskultur, Organisationsgestaltung und Personalprozesse.

Die Position bietet erfahrenen Recruiter:innen die Möglichkeit, den nächsten Schritt in eine umfassendere People-Rolle zu machen. Ein fertiges HR-Handbuch, das du einfach übernimmst, gibt es nicht. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir Prozesse, lösen neue Herausforderungen, probieren Ideen aus und schaffen die Grundlagen für das Wachstum von Rivia. Durch praktische Verantwortung, enge Zusammenarbeit und Einblicke in strategische Entscheidungen wie auch operative Herausforderungen lernst du direkt von der Leitung des People-Bereichs.

Du bist die enge Sparringspartner:in der Leitung des People-Bereichs: Du denkst selbstständig, arbeitest vertrauensvoll zusammen und packst mit an. Du bringst Ideen ein, hinterfragst Annahmen, handelst schnell und setzt Vorhaben konsequent um. Gesucht ist jemand, der versteht, wie People-Arbeit zum Geschäftserfolg beiträgt, und Führungskräfte wirklich beraten möchte – statt lediglich Prozesse abzuarbeiten.

Was dich begeistert

  • Du liebst Recruiting, möchtest dich aber über Talent Acquisition hinaus weiterentwickeln und das gesamte People-Spektrum kennenlernen.

  • Die erste Person im People-Team zu sein und alles von Grund auf mit aufzubauen, reizt dich mehr, als ein bestehendes Handbuch zu pflegen.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit der Leitung des People-Bereichs zusammen, hinterfragst Ideen und lernst durch echte Verantwortung.

  • Du findest außergewöhnliche Talente und baust vertrauensvolle Partnerschaften mit den einstellenden Führungskräften auf.

  • Du löst komplexe Geschäfts- und People-Fragen schnell, neugierig und pragmatisch.

  • Du möchtest die Mitarbeitererfahrung, Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und Zusammenarbeit verbessern.

  • Du ergreifst die Initiative, behältst verschiedene Prioritäten im Blick und siehst direkt, was deine Arbeit bewirkt.

Deine Aufgaben

Talent Acquisition

  • Du verantwortest den gesamten Einstellungsprozess über alle Teams hinweg – von der Definition der Rolle über Talent Mapping, Active Sourcing, Interviews und die Betreuung der Kandidat:innen bis hin zu Angeboten und Vertragsabschlüssen.

  • Du berätst einstellende Führungskräfte fundiert zu Recruiting-Strategie, Marktbedingungen, Qualität der Kandidat:innen und möglichen Kompromissen.

  • Du baust proaktiv Talent-Pipelines auf und sorgst für eine wertschätzende, verlässliche Candidate Experience.

  • Du verbesserst Recruiting-Prozesse, ATS-Workflows, Reporting und Recruiting-Analysen.

Mitarbeitererfahrung und Entwicklung

  • Gemeinsam mit der Leitung des People-Bereichs entwickelst du Onboarding, Mitarbeitererfahrung, Engagement, Unternehmenskultur und Entwicklungsinitiativen weiter.

  • Du unterstützt die Einführung von Performance Reviews, Feedback-Praktiken, Karriereentwicklung und Angeboten für Führungskräfte.

  • Du hörst den Anliegen von Mitarbeitenden und Führungskräften zu, erkennst Reibungspunkte und setzt Erkenntnisse in konkrete Verbesserungen um.

People Operations und Business-Partnerschaft

  • Du hilfst dabei, skalierbare People-Prozesse, Richtlinien, Systeme und Abläufe entlang des gesamten Beschäftigungsverhältnisses von Grund auf aufzubauen.

  • Du unterstützt Führungskräfte mit pragmatischer, geschäftsorientierter Beratung und durchdachten Personalentscheidungen.

  • Mit wachsendem Verantwortungsbereich arbeitest du an Projekten zu Organisationsgestaltung, Vergütung, HR Operations und People Analytics mit.

  • Du erkennst Probleme früh, schlägst Lösungen vor und kümmerst dich um deren Umsetzung, statt auf Anweisungen zu warten.

Was du mitbringst

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse.

  • Umfassende Erfahrung im Recruiting über den gesamten Einstellungsprozess hinweg sowie nachweisbare Erfolge bei der eigenständigen Besetzung anspruchsvoller Positionen.

  • Den Wunsch, dich in eine umfassendere People-Rolle weiterzuentwickeln; Erfahrung als HR-Generalist:in ist nicht erforderlich.

  • Du baust gern Neues auf, löst Probleme, handelst schnell, denkst kritisch und übernimmst Verantwortung bis zur Umsetzung.

  • Geschäftssinn und die Sicherheit, einstellende Führungskräfte und andere Verantwortliche zu hinterfragen, zu überzeugen und zu beraten.

  • Du fühlst dich wohl mit offenen Fragestellungen, hohen Erwartungen, mehreren parallelen Prioritäten und praktischer Arbeit.

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit, gutes Urteilsvermögen, Organisationstalent und Erfahrung im Stakeholder-Management.

  • Neugier, Bescheidenheit und die Bereitschaft, neue People-Fachgebiete zu erschließen.

Von Vorteil

  • Kenntnisse des Schweizer Arbeitsrechts.

  • Einblicke in Mitarbeiterentwicklung, Performance Management oder Mitarbeiterengagement.

  • Erfahrung in einem Startup oder Scale-up sowie Vertrautheit mit ATS-, HRIS- oder People-Analytics-Systemen.

Bewerbungsprozess

Unser Bewerbungsprozess dauert in der Regel zwei bis vier Wochen und umfasst vier Schritte:

  1. Kennenlernen: 30-minütiges erstes Gespräch mit dem People-Team.

  2. Vertiefendes Gespräch: Austausch mit der Leitung des People-Bereichs über Recruiting, Business-Partnerschaft und deine Entwicklungsziele.

  3. Praxisaufgabe: Gemeinsame Bearbeitung einer realistischen Recruiting- und People-Herausforderung.

  4. Kennenlernen des Teams: Gespräche vor Ort in Zürich, um herauszufinden, ob wir gut zueinander passen.

Unsere Werte

Bei Rivia setzen wir auf Spitzenleistung, kontinuierliches Lernen und den Erfolg unserer Kund:innen und unseres Teams.

  • Mit vollem Einsatz gewinnen: Herausforderungen mit Entschlossenheit, Ausdauer und Tatkraft angehen.

  • Veränderung annehmen: Wandel als Chance zur Verbesserung sehen.

  • Warum eigentlich nicht?: Annahmen hinterfragen und neugierig bleiben.

  • Lücken erkennen: Probleme frühzeitig identifizieren und lösen.

  • Gemeinsam Verantwortung übernehmen: Zusammen für Ergebnisse einstehen und einander unterstützen.

  • Lösungen mit Mehrwert schaffen: Sinnvolle Ergebnisse erzielen, die wirklich etwas bewirken.

Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

BLP only works when it talks to our customers’ ERP systems. As an Integration Engineer, you build and own those connections and keep live integrations running for enterprise customers. Every new ERP system is a new problem to solve. You’ll lead our Oracle integrations across Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards, while also contributing to other integrations.

 

What you’ll do

  • Own our integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards and ensure their market fit, usability and reliability.

  • Design and implement interfaces for diverse protocols: REST, SOAP, direct DB access and file transfers.

  • Explore new ERP systems and determine the best way to connect them.

  • Build new ERP integrations, often in close collaboration with pilot customers.

  • Own existing integrations end to end, including issue resolution, and document them so teammates can pick them up.

  • Enable technical project managers to consult on, install and configure mature integrations.

 

What you'll bring

  • Hands-on integration experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, ideally more than one. You have built or maintained interfaces yourself, not only used the system as a functional consultant or key user.

  • Experience with the native interfaces of at least one of these:

    • Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP: REST and SOAP web services, File-Based Data Import (FBDI) through the ERP Integration Service, and data extraction with BI Publisher or BI Cloud Connector (BICC).

    • NetSuite: SuiteTalk REST and SOAP web services, SuiteQL, SuiteScript 2.x (e.g., RESTlets, Map/Reduce scripts), and Token-Based Authentication or OAuth 2.0.

    • JD Edwards EnterpriseOne: AIS Server and Orchestrator, Business Services (BSSV), and Z-file interface tables (e.g., F0411Z1) with their batch processors.

  • A good understanding of purchase-to-pay data in Oracle ERPs: suppliers, purchase orders, receipts and supplier invoice matching.

  • Solid programming skills in at least one backend language. We build our integrations in Go. If you come from Java, C#, Python or similar and are keen to pick up Go, that works for us.

  • A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • A structured, self-reliant way of working, and ideally experience in a client-facing role.

  • Fluent English. German is a plus, as most of our customers are in the DACH region.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with both cloud (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite) and on-premise (JD Edwards) environments, and the constraints of each (e.g., no direct database access in Fusion, governance limits in NetSuite).

  • Extensive experience with SQL, common data formats (JSON, XML, CSV) and transports (REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP).

  • Familiarity with modern engineering practices: Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD.

  • Integration experience with other ERPs, such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Infor.

 

Integration Engineer or Senior Integration Engineer

We hire at both levels. Four things decide where you start: years of experience, breadth of experience, coaching experience and scope.

Integration Engineer

  • Years: 2+ years of hands-on integration work, including Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards.

  • Breadth: in-depth experience with one Oracle ERP and its interfaces.

  • Coaching: you learn quickly from senior colleagues and share what you learn with the team.

  • Scope: you deliver and maintain integrations and resolve issues independently, with guidance on architecture decisions.

Senior Integration Engineer

  • Years: 5+ years of hands-on integration work, several of them with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards.

  • Breadth: integration experience across two or more of Fusion, NetSuite and JD Edwards, or across Oracle and other ERPs, in cloud and on-premise environments.

  • Coaching: you have coached or mentored other engineers and help technical project managers grow.

  • Scope: you own our Oracle integrations end to end, set technical direction and take on the most complex customer cases.

Why BLP

  • Real impact: your integrations decide whether a customer goes live.

  • Breadth: Oracle, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics and many other ERPs, plus EDI and e-invoicing standards.

  • Growth: fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares.

  • Team: regular team events.

Practical information

  • Location: our Zurich office, hybrid with 3+ office days per week, or remotely from anywhere in Europe.

  • If you work remotely, we pay for regular visits and stays in Zurich.

  • Employment: full-time, permanent.

 

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation and control stack of the fusion energy reactors of the future.

Our technology enables effective and reliable operation, monitoring, and analysis of high-temperature plasmas in fusion devices — which will one day provide clean, practically limitless power to the grid. We have spun out of EPFL’s Swiss Plasma Center and have just completed our pre-seed fundraise.

We are looking for a Senior Control Systems Engineer to join our founding team in Lausanne and help build our core technology.

This job is for you if you are a passionate engineer with deep knowledge cutting across real-time / embedded systems, software and hardware, and excited about building the systems to monitor and control real-world fusion plasmas.

Tasks

  • Implement real-time control, analysis, data acquisition systems in the kHz to MHz range, as individual contributor and in a team.
  • Integrate solutions across a variety of company products and services as well as on our in-house test beds.
  • Provide technical leadership within a growing real-time control and software engineering team that you will help to build.
  • Translate customer needs into requirements and specifications.

Requirements

  • Experience taking hard-real-time acquisition and control loops from incomplete requirements through to commissioning on hardware, in domains such as automotive, robotics, embedded, electrical and/or scientific instrumentation.
  • ‘Full stack’: familiarity with all aspects of real-time technologies, from physical/DAQ, real-time software frameworks and middleware, real-time OS and integration.
  • Fluency in a mix of high-level and low-level languages such as C, C++, Rust, MATLAB/Simulink, Python. Obsession with code quality, testing and reliability.
  • Experience with distributed real-time systems, real-time networking and field buses and/or SCADA is an advantage.
  • Experience with embedded/μC/FPGA technologies and/or safety critical systems is an advantage.

Benefits

  • The unique opportunity to play a foundational role at a dynamic, fast-growing startup, shaping the technical solutions and products from the ground up.
  • The opportunity to build cutting edge technology to monitor and control plasmas in real fusion devices, working side-by-side with leading plasma and control experts.
  • Great working conditions, located in Lausanne, Switzerland, a city and country known for its high quality of life.
  • Competitive salary and equity compensation and benefits including immigration assistance.

If you are excited about joining our team, send your CV including information about a real-time system you have taken into operation. We're looking forward to hearing from you.

Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

The Opportunity

Toqan is Prosus's internal AI platform — the infrastructure and tooling layer that powers agentic AI-driven products across the entire group.We are building secure, configurable agent runtimes that can operate reliably at scale across different products, channels and use cases..  

You’ll work where distributed systems meet applied AI: orchestrating models and tools, enabling agents to perform long-running work, and turning rapidly evolving AI capabilities into dependable platform primitives. The challenges span asynchronous workflows, isolated execution, extensible integrations, reliability, observability and cost control.

The Toqan platform serves the whole Prosus portfolio and other connected businesses, which means the backend systems you build here have reach far beyond a single team. You'll join a 12-person engineering team in Amsterdam and work closely with product, platform and AI colleagues to ship end-to-end — at pace, without compromising quality.

Who You Are

You are a senior backend engineer who has moved well past following patterns and into setting them. You're comfortable owning architectural decisions on novel infrastructure — the kind where the right answer isn't obvious and the stakes are real. You think in systems, spot failure modes early, and hold a high bar for production quality without letting perfect block good. The 80/20 mindset comes naturally: you know when to go deep and when to ship.

You've likely come from a startup or high-velocity environment where shipping fast wasn't a culture slogan — it was survival. You know how to cut scope without cutting corners, move from zero to production without a safety net, and iterate quickly on systems that are still finding their shape.

You're genuinely curious about the AI and LLM space — not as a trend to track, but as a domain where you've already done hands-on integration work and want to go further. AI tools aren't an afterthought in how you work — you use them daily, whether that's Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or OpenAI Codex, and you've developed real judgment about where they accelerate work and where they don't. You operate with low ego, share context freely, and thrive in an environment where autonomy and accountability go hand in hand. Ambiguity doesn't slow you down — it's where you do your best work.

What You Bring

  • Strong Go programming skills with a track record of building and operating production backend services

  • Hands-on AWS experience — designing, deploying, and operating cloud-native services at scale

  • Experience integrating LLMs, AI models or tool-calling systems into production applications

  • Familiarity with agentic architectures and protocols such as MCP, A2A

  • A systems mindset, with attention to reliability, scalability, performance and security

  • Experience with CI/CD, automated testing and production observability

  • A record of working across product and platform teams to deliver outcomes end-to-end

  • Regular, thoughtful use of AI coding tools as part of your development workflow

Nice to haves

  • Hands-on experience building agentic AI systems that use tools and execute multi-step workflows

  • Experience building or maintaining event-sourced systems

  • Python programming skills

  • Experience with AI or ML infrastructure and developer productivity tooling

Your Typical Day

No two days look exactly the same. You might design a new capability for the agent runtime, improve how models and tools are orchestrated, investigate a production reliability issue, or take an integration from an early prototype to a secure, observable service.

You’ll spend much of your time building in Go, reviewing code and making architectural decisions with the team. You’ll also work closely with product, platform and AI colleagues to shape requirements, test ideas and ship them safely. Along the way, you’ll improve the testing, deployment and observability foundations that let the team move quickly with confidence.

What We Offer

  • Global Impact: Play a crucial role in shaping the future of global commerce.

  • Growth Opportunities: Expand your expertise through diverse global challenges and unique opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Join a forward-thinking team that values strategic insights and fosters continuous innovation.

  • Creative Environment: Engage in work that encourages creativity and constant improvement.

  • Collaborative Atmosphere: Benefit from autonomy and self-management in a supportive and positive workspace.

  • Hybrid Work: Experience the satisfaction of our flexible model tailored to balance work and life.

  • Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a salary package that reflects your skills and contributions.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: From health and wellness to learning, commuting, and everyday perks, we offer a well-rounded package designed to help you thrive at work and beyond.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

About The Role

Commissioning is where an AI factory becomes real. As Senior Director, Global Commissioning & Handover, you will lead commissioning of DSX facilities and network across all of Volta's sites, taking each one to ready for service and handing it over to our operations teams.

You will build and lead a global team that owns Volta's commissioning standards for electrical, mechanical and CDU scopes, systems security, commissioning planning, facilities readiness and operational readiness. Your team sets how commissioning is done on every site, from tagging through to the turn-up sequence, and holds the schedule that takes each facility live.

Time to market matters here. You will align commissioning to the turn-up sequence so that commissioning accelerates service rather than delays it, and you will make sure that when a building is handed over, the operations team, the procedures and the systems are ready to run it.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead commissioning of DSX facilities and network infrastructure across Volta's AI factories, taking each site to ready for service.

  • Build and lead the global Commissioning and Handover team, covering electrical, mechanical and CDU commissioning standards, systems security, commissioning planning, facilities readiness and operational readiness.

  • Own Volta's commissioning standards for each discipline, from tagging and method statements through each commissioning level to the turn-up sequence.

  • Own CDU installation and commissioning standards, including handover to operations.

  • Own the commissioning schedule for every site and its alignment to turn-up, so that commissioning is never the critical path to service.

  • Deliver the physical and systems security requirements for each site from construction through tohandover.

  • Set the facilities readiness and operational readiness standards and governance, so each facility is ready for operations and the operations team is ready to run it.

  • Lead handover into service, working with DC Operations on acceptance, documentation and training.

  • Work with Design and Engineering, the regional delivery teams and the DSX execution and network teams so commissioning is integrated into the master schedule on every site.

  • Report commissioning progress and risk across sites, and feed lessons learned back into the standards and the reference design.

What You Bring

  • Experience leading commissioning of hyperscale data centres, including electrical, mechanical and liquid cooling systems. Data centre experience is essential.

  • A track record owning commissioning and handover across multiple concurrent sites at this level, and the ability to run it from day one.

  • Deep knowledge of commissioning levels, integrated systems testing and the turn-up sequence for high density GPU environments.

  • Experience with CDU and liquid cooling commissioning and handover into operations.

  • Experience setting readiness governance and handing live facilities over to operations teams.

  • Experience building and leading commissioning teams and managing commissioning agents and contractors.

  • Understanding of physical and systems security requirements in mission critical facilities.

  • Willingness to travel to sites across Europe and North America.

About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to rapid growth in our partner lab network, we are seeking a Scientific Product Manager to join our Product team and bring partner labs and their experimental workflows onto the CuspAI platform.

Your impact

This is an exciting opportunity to join the product team at CuspAI, working closely with materials scientists, ML researchers and platform engineers to make AI-driven experimentation work in real laboratories. As one of a small team of Scientific Product Managers, you will take ownership of a set of partner labs and the lab integration work around them, translating what each lab actually needs into requirements our engineers and ML researchers can build against. Alongside the product work, you will spend real time with your partners' teams and their experimental data.

What You Will Do

Product Requirements & Roadmap

  • Shape and prioritise the roadmap for how experimental data, protocols and campaigns get into the CuspAI platform, together with your fellow Scientific Product Managers, the engineering lead and the wider product team.

  • Write requirements, specifications and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from, covering experiment types, instrument integrations and LIMS/ELN connections, and work with the data team on the underlying data models and provenance.

  • Contribute to decisions on what we build, what we integrate, and what we leave to partners' existing systems.

Partner Lab Onboarding

  • Lead technical discovery with the partner labs you take on: map their workflows, instruments, sample logic and data systems, and pin down the true experimental unit and the parameters that matter.

  • Own onboarding for your partner labs from scoping to the first closed-loop campaign, and turn each onboarding into reusable patterns and documentation shared across the team so the next one is faster.

  • Act as the main scientific counterpart for the partner labs you look after, and represent the product in partner meetings, workshops and conferences.

Closed-Loop Campaigns

  • Work with ML researchers to design optimisation campaigns (e.g. Bayesian optimisation) that respect real experimental constraints such as throughput, noise and failed samples.

  • Define how platform-driven campaigns are validated, including benchmarks against manual or legacy workflows, success metrics and the evidence we bring to partners.

Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

  • PhD in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, Chemical Engineering or a related experimental discipline, or equivalent experience in scientific research.

  • Hands-on experience with high-throughput or automated experimentation (e.g. robotic synthesis, combinatorial libraries, automated characterisation, or self-driving / closed-loop labs) in industry, a national lab or research institute, or academia.

  • Proven track record of translating scientific or process needs into requirements for engineers, software teams or automation vendors, and of validating that what was built works in the lab.

  • Firsthand understanding of how experimental data is produced and where it fails: which metadata and provenance matter, instrument quirks, data quality issues, and what makes a dataset usable for machine learning.

  • Depth in at least one materials domain (e.g. semiconductors and thin films including photovoltaics, catalysis and electrochemistry, energy materials including batteries, polymers and formulations, or separations and surfaces) and the curiosity to work across others.

  • Working knowledge of Python for data handling and analysis; comfortable working with APIs and data schemas.

  • Strong communicator and a proven collaborator, comfortable working directly with external partner labs as well as multidisciplinary science, ML, product and engineering teams.

Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Direct experience with closed-loop optimisation in an automated setting, such as Bayesian optimisation, active learning or design of experiments.

  • Experience with research data management, LIMS/ELN systems, FAIR data or metadata schemas, and familiarity with lab data standards (e.g. SiLA 2, AnIML, Allotrope).

  • Instrument integration experience, including vendor software, data formats, and scheduling or orchestration.

  • Product or project management experience, such as roadmaps, user research, external research collaborations or vendor relationships. We are equally open to strong experimental scientists making their first move into product.

  • Experience working in industry at a materials, chemicals, energy or deep-tech company, or closely with industry at a research institution or national lab.

  • Experience coordinating work across multiple labs, sites or countries.

Additional Considerations

This role could be based in any of our locations with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to partner labs and other locations for collaboration and project work.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.

Als Senior Data Engineering Consultant bij BigData Republic adviseer je toonaangevende organisaties in Nederland over complexe data-vraagstukken. Je combineert hands-on engineering met een adviserende rol: je schrijft productie-klare code, denkt mee over strategische bedrijfsbeslissingen en begeleidt collega’s om naar een hoger niveau te groeien.

Je hebt je carrière opgebouwd rond het ontwerpen en bouwen van datasystemen. Je werkt graag inhoudelijk mee, maar verliest kwaliteit, schaalbaarheid en duurzaamheid nooit uit het oog. Je bent een ervaren Data Engineer die vaak moeilijk in één functie te vatten is, omdat je op meerdere niveaus impact maakt. En je bent toe aan een nieuwe uitdaging.

Bij BigData Republic ontwikkelen we data-applicaties, bouwen we data-platformen, creëren we voorspellende modellen en ontwerpen we robuuste data-infrastructuren. We werken vanuit een software-engineering mindset, met focus op technische hoogstaande kwaliteit.

Kennisdeling en thought leadership vormen de kern van onze cultuur. Elke vrijdag organiseren we kennissessies op kantoor, we schrijven blogs, organiseren meetups en bezoeken en spreken op conferenties.

Je werkt aan complexe projecten voor grote klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren, terwijl je onderdeel bent van een klein, informeel en hecht team van vakgenoten dat elkaar uitdaagt en inspireert. Bij BigData Republic ben je de expert in de kamer én leer je elke dag van je collega’s. En vooral: je kunt hier jezelf zijn.

In de praktijk besteed je ongeveer 90% van je tijd aan klantprojecten. De overige tijd is expliciet gereserveerd voor eigen initiatieven: een pet project, innovatie of een idee dat je samen met collega’s wilt uitwerken.

Je hebt een sterke basis in;

Je hoeft niet alles te beheersen. Nieuwsgierigheid, leergierigheid en technische diepgang vinden we belangrijker dan een perfecte checklist.

Wij zijn voor de Rijksinspectie Digitale Infrastructuur (RDI) op zoek naar een ervaren Projectleider. De RDI zet zich in voor een veilig verbonden Nederland en werkt aan actuele thema’s zoals cyberveiligheid, digitale weerbaarheid, AI, 5G en digitale infrastructuur.

De opdracht vindt plaats binnen de directie Digitale Weerbaarheid en richt zich op de organisatie van de NISDUC 2027 (NIS Directive User Community), een internationaal congres op het gebied van digitale weerbaarheid, cybersecurity en toezicht. Tijdens dit congres komen toezichthouders, overheden en professionals uit Nederland, België en Luxemburg samen om kennis en ervaringen uit te wisselen rondom onder meer NIS2 en cybersecurity.

Als Projectleider ben je verantwoordelijk voor de inhoudelijke en organisatorische aansturing van het congres en zorg je voor een succesvolle realisatie van het programma en de samenwerking met alle betrokken partijen.

  • Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring binnen het cybersecuritydomein.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Cosmetic Chemist for our KEUNE Beauty Solutions team. You combine excellent formulation skills with the confidence to tackle development projects independently. You will remain closely involved in hands-on laboratory work while taking responsibility for assigned projects, guiding fellow medior and junior chemists, and working directly with clients and cross-functional teams to bring high-performing products to market.

At KEUNE, we develop and manufacture not only our own professional haircare products but also products for KEUNE Beauty Solutions (KBS), our private label division. Through KBS, we partner with beauty brands worldwide, offering end-to-end solutions from formulation development and manufacturing to the delivery of finished products.

MISSION

  • Lead assigned new product development projects from brief to commercialization, taking ownership of technical execution, deliverables, timelines, and follow-up in line with the NPD process.

  • Develop and optimize haircare, hairstyling, and hair color formulations through hands-on laboratory work, ensuring product performance, safety, quality, and regulatory compliance.

  • Act as technical reference for assigned projects: review client briefs, clarify requirements, identify risks, and translate expectations into a clear development plan.

  • Participate in and lead technical discussions with clients, working alongside Project Management and Commercial teams to align expectations, feasibility, and next steps.

  • Provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level chemists working on shared projects, while maintaining ownership for project outcomes.

  • Plan, organize, execute, document, and follow up on submissions, stability, safety, and performance testing, ensuring decisions and results are properly tracked.

  • Proactively identify potential delays or technical challenges, communicate them early, and drive practical solutions with the relevant stakeholders.

  • Support scale-up, first production runs, and troubleshooting in collaboration with Production and Quality Control.

  • Stay informed about market trends, emerging ingredients, and technologies, and turn insights into relevant innovation concepts and proposals for clients.

  • Apply appropriate instrumental and analytical methods to evaluate formulations, substantiate performance, and support technical decisions.

YOU

  • Master's degree in Chemistry, Cosmetic Science, or a related field.

  • At least 7 years of relevant cosmetic formulation and development experience, with strong expertise in hair products.

  • A proven track record of developing and successfully launching cosmetic products.

  • Strong hands-on formulation skills, paired with the ability to organize and tackle multiple development activities.

  • A proactive, independent, and accountable working style: you take initiative, follow through on commitments, and know when to escalate issues.

  • Confidence in leading technical client conversations, challenging or clarifying briefs constructively, and managing expectations together with cross-functional colleagues.

  • Ability to guide junior and mid-level chemists.

  • Excellent communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, including the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Curiosity about innovation, new ingredients, and opportunities to improve products and ways of working.

  • Eligible to work in the Netherlands



OUR OFFER

  • A sustainably-conscious employer;

  • Travel allowance

  • 27 vacation days per year (based on full-time employment);

  • Relocation support

  • A good pension plan;

  • A competitive salary;

  • 8% holiday pay;

  • And never have a "bad hair day" again thanks to staff discounts on the entire Keune collection!

  • Attention to your mental well-being through unlimited access to OpenUp

  • Participation in group classes at Personal Fitness Soest

KEUNE

We are a family business with a long-term vision, where science is at the heart of everything we do. Our story begins in 1922, in Amsterdam. Today, KEUNE belongs to one of the fastest growing brands in professional hair care products. From our headquarters in Soest, KEUNE products are developed, produced and distributed worldwide to more than 85 countries. And we have no intention of slowing down! Every year we open a new site of our own. We produce in a sustainable and animal-friendly way and are B Corp-certified. But KEUNE is not just about creating beautiful products - it's about our story and our vision.  KEUNE is led by Philip Berlijn, who is focused on building a strong brand and creating a corporate culture that is all about collaboration, sustainability and showing character

OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

We are committed to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive work environment. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. We do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, nationality, religion or belief, age, disability, neurodiversity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know, and we will work with you to support your participation.

Bij Beter Healthcare draait accountmanagement niet in de eerste plaats om de cijfers. Het draait om mensen, vertrouwen en trots zijn op wat je doet, en om de sterke drive om de zorg én Beter Healthcare stap voor stap vooruit te helpen. Elke dag weer.

Wat je gaat doen

Als (Senior) Accountmanager ben jij voor nieuwe zorgorganisaties vaak de eerste kennismaking met Beter Healthcare. Je richt je op ziekenhuizen, GGZ- en VVT-organisaties en samenwerkingsverbanden waar we nog niet of nauwelijks werken. Je verkoopt geen product, maar dienstverlening: advies, projectmanagement, interim-inzet en implementatie, samen met de consultants die de inhoud brengen.

Je zoekt actief kansen op, weet klant behoeften niet alleen te identificeren maar ook te sturen en laat je niet uit het veld slaan door een nee. Tegelijk verkoop je niets wat niet past: je begint bij echte interesse in de klant en zijn uitdagingen. En je bent een echte teamspeler. Eerst het team, daarna jijzelf. Geen groot ego, geen solist. Je groeit hard mee met ons bedrijf, helemaal in lijn met onze missie: hoe meer we groeien, hoe groter onze positieve impact op de zorg.

Jouw werkzaamheden omvatten onder andere:

·       Je brengt de markt in kaart, kiest doelorganisaties en bouwt een gerichte pipeline op;

·       Je legt contact met CIO's, CMIO's, managers informatievoorziening, inkopers en bestuurders, via je eigen netwerk en actieve acquisitie;

·       Je verkent in gesprekken wat er echt speelt en vertaalt dat samen met consultants naar een passend voorstel;

·       Je stelt offertes op en onderhandelt over inzet, tarieven en voorwaarden;

·       Je volgt aanbestedingen en raamovereenkomsten en coördineert inschrijvingen;

·       Je vertegenwoordigt Beter Healthcare op netwerkevenementen, congressen en vakbijeenkomsten, op een manier die past bij onze waarden: betrokken, betrouwbaar en bekwaam;

·       Je rapporteert over pipeline, forecast en kansen aan het managementteam en hebt dat gewoon goed op orde.


Wie jij bent

Je bent geen typische verkoper. Je bent een ondernemende verbinder: iemand die nieuwe kansen ziet, deuren durft te openen en mensen en organisaties oprecht wil begrijpen. Herken jij jezelf hierin?

·       Je haalt energie uit het binnenhalen van nieuwe klanten en hebt het doorzettingsvermogen dat daarbij hoort;

·       Je hebt een intrinsieke drive om bij te dragen aan betere zorg door digitalisering;

·       Je bent nieuwsgierig en leergierig: de wereld van zorg en ICT blijft je boeien en je houdt je kennis actief bij;

·       Je bent een echte teamspeler en zet het gezamenlijke resultaat boven je eigen ego;

·       Je hebt minimaal acht jaar ervaring in de verkoop van dienstverlening, zoals consultancy, interim of detachering, in de zorg-ICT;

·       Je hebt een trackrecord in het binnenhalen van nieuwe klanten en kent de inkoop- en aanbestedingsprocessen in de zorg;

·       Je beschikt over een actief netwerk bij zorgorganisaties, bij voorkeur op het niveau van CIO, CMIO, IM-management of bestuur;

·       Je hebt hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau;

·       Je communiceert helder en overtuigend in het Nederlands, mondeling en schriftelijk.

Wat je van ons mag verwachten

Bij Beter Healthcare kom je terecht in een werkomgeving die draait om groei, vertrouwen en samenwerking. Je kunt rekenen op:

·       Een goed salaris dat we bepalen op basis van jouw kennis en ervaring;

·       Sterke secundaire voorwaarden, zoals een leaseauto, bonusregeling, pensioen, laptop en telefoon;

·       Een rol met echte impact: jij opent de deuren waardoor Beter Healthcare kan groeien en de zorg kan verbeteren;

·       Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en invloed op onze commerciële koers;

·       Ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen, zowel commercieel als inhoudelijk;

·       Kennisgroepen, intervisies en ontwikkelmogelijkheden om continu te blijven leren;

·       Interactieve kwartaalbijeenkomsten met collega's op inspirerende locaties;

·       Een hecht team van gedreven healthcare consultants dat altijd met je meedenkt;

·       Een actieve personeelsvereniging voor wie het leuk vindt om samen dingen te ondernemen;

·       Heel veel plezier in een prachtig team.

Over Beter Healthcare

Beter Healthcare is een consultancybureau op het snijvlak van zorg en ICT. We ondersteunen zorgorganisaties bij de digitalisering van hun processen en dragen zo bij aan een toekomstbestendige zorg. We zijn al met zo'n 100 IT healthcare specialisten en we groeien hard: niet als doel op zich, maar omdat onze klanten ons nodig hebben en onze aanpak werkt.

Sinds 2012 helpen we zorgorganisaties met advies, projectmanagement en beheer. Onze kracht is dat we niet alleen adviseren, maar ook samen met klanten oplossingen succesvol implementeren. Onze consultants kennen de zorg van binnenuit, en dat maakt echt het verschil.

Beter Healthcare is onderdeel van IG&H, een toonaangevend adviesbureau dat verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor de resultaten van zijn werk. Met de eigen ‘Make Strategy Work’-methodologie richt IG&H zich op digitale transformaties. Binnen IG&H Health werken we samen met teams die gespecialiseerd zijn in onder meer strategy consulting, data en AI, security en managed cloudservices.

Voel jij een “ja”?

Zie jij jezelf hierin terug en wil je met jouw energie en talent bijdragen aan de groei van Beter Healthcare én aan betere zorg in Nederland? Vul dan het sollicitatieformulier in. We ontmoeten je graag!

ennovationHUB is a rapidly growing international e-commerce group operating in the home & living category, with a strong focus on furniture. From our hubs in Belgrade, Barcelona, and London, we serve customers across the UK, North America, EU, and APAC.

As we work toward €160m+ annual revenue by 2027, we are looking for a Senior Google Ads Specialist to join us ASAP and take ownership of Google Ads performance for one of our portfolio brands, with direct accountability for growth, efficiency, and profitability.

This is not a typical agency PPC role focused on managing a handful of campaigns. You will join a multi-brand international e-commerce group with significant advertising budgets, multiple markets, and a clear view of how your work influences revenue and profitability.

Google Ads is central to our growth strategy. Working across multiple countries and brands brings both complexity and opportunity. We are looking for people who enjoy working with large datasets, identifying performance opportunities, and consistently improving results through testing, analysis, and execution.

You will collaborate closely with our Head of Performance Marketing, creative team, and data specialists to ensure campaigns perform well today and continue to scale efficiently as the business grows.

  • Take ownership of Google Ads performance for one e-commerce brand across multiple international markets

  • Manage and optimise Google Ads campaigns across Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and other relevant campaign types

  • Monitor and improve key performance metrics including ROAS, CPA, conversion rate, revenue, and profitability

  • Be directly accountable for growth, efficiency, and performance within your portfolio

  • Identify growth opportunities across products, categories, markets, and audience segments

  • Analyse campaign data and turn insights into actionable recommendations

  • Conduct account audits and implement ongoing optimisation initiatives

  • Work closely with developers and analytics teams to ensure accurate tracking and measurement

  • Collaborate with creative and content teams to improve ad performance and landing page effectiveness

  • Support budget planning, forecasting, and performance reporting

  • Stay current with platform developments, AI-driven advertising features, and industry best practices

  • Contribute to testing strategies and experimentation frameworks that improve long-term account performance

You will be joining a business where Google Ads already delivers results. Your role is to build on that success by identifying opportunities, improving efficiency, and scaling what works. We operate in a competitive e-commerce environment where even small improvements can have a significant impact.

You will work alongside experienced colleagues who move quickly and care about results. We value people who think independently, challenge assumptions with data, and take ownership of outcomes. This is not a support or reporting role. You will be trusted to make decisions, own results, and directly influence the growth of the business.


This role is strictly for candidates with in-house e-commerce experience. Applicants whose primary Google Ads experience comes from agencies, consultancies, or freelance work will not be considered.

We are looking for people who have owned performance outcomes within an e-commerce business, where success is measured by revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, and long-term growth rather than client management and campaign delivery. You should have experience working directly within a commercial business and feel comfortable taking responsibility for results, beyond simply providing recommendations.

Our Ideal Candidate Will Have:

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads campaigns

  • Proven hands-on experience managing Google Ads for an e-commerce business, with direct responsibility for performance and profitability

  • Strong experience with Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns

  • Proven experience working as part of an in-house e-commerce team rather than as an agency, consultant, or freelancer

  • Comfortable analysing large datasets and identifying actionable insights

  • Strong understanding of attribution, tracking, and performance measurement

  • Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and Google Merchant Center

  • Highly analytical with strong attention to detail

  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities

  • Curious, proactive, and focused on continuous improvement

  • Able to take ownership and make decisions independently

  • We are actively pushing AI and automation across the business, so you need to be comfortable working in that direction and not resistant to change

  • Senior, but practical

  • Data-driven without becoming overly theoretical

  • Comfortable taking ownership and making decisions

  • Naturally curious and always looking for performance improvements

  • Focused on outcomes rather than activity

  • Able to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution

  • Motivated by building and scaling rather than simply maintaining campaigns

  • Available to start immediately / ASAP

We are investing in strengthening our presence there and expect it to become an increasingly important location for our team over time. Our wider team works across London, Belgrade, Barcelona, Frankfurt, Oxfordshire, Istanbul, and Guangzhou.

The role involves travel approximately every 4-8 weeks to Belgrade, Barcelona, London, or other team locations for planning sessions, workshops, team gatherings, and strategic discussions. While most work takes place remotely, we value spending time together in person, particularly as the company continues to scale.

This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to make a meaningful contribution to scaling an international e-commerce business over the coming years.

In Our Culture at ennovationHUB, We Value:

  • Accountability over excuses

  • Execution over talk

  • Clarity over politics

  • Learning through doing

We welcome people from diverse backgrounds. What matters most is the quality of your work, taking ownership, and helping the business move forward.

MVRDV zoekt een Senior Financial Controller om ons Finance & Operations team in Rotterdam te versterken.

Je bent de financiële rechterhand van onze Head of Finance en de dagelijkse sparringpartner voor Project Managers, Directors en collega's binnen Finance. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in zowel project control als financial control en zorgt ervoor dat financiële informatie betrouwbaar, tijdig en bruikbaar is voor de organisatie.

Je ondersteunt Project Managers bij het monitoren en verbeteren van projectresultaten, terwijl je tegelijkertijd bijdraagt aan een hoogwaardige financiële verslaggeving, een betrouwbare jaarafsluiting en een succesvolle accountantscontrole. Met jouw analytische blik, financiële expertise en hands-on mentaliteit lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan de verdere professionalisering van onze financiële organisatie.

MVRDV is een wereldwijd erkend bureau voor architectuur en stedenbouw, met hoofdkantoor in Rotterdam en vestigingen in Shanghai, Parijs, Berlijn en New York. Opgericht in 1993 door Winy Maas, Jacob van Rijs en Nathalie de Vries, ontwerpt MVRDV innovatieve, sociaal verantwoorde en duurzame architectuur die de toekomst vormgeeft. Als collega bij MVRDV maak je deel uit van een energiek, internationaal team van meer dan 250 professionals uit meer dan 40 nationaliteiten.

Verantwoordelijkheden

Project Control

  • Samenwerken met Project Managers bij het opstellen en beoordelen van projectbudgetten, fee-calculaties en forecasts.

  • Financiële projectprestaties monitoren, waaronder omzet, kosten, marge, WIP en cashflow, en risico's en kansen tijdig signaleren.

  • Variantie- en scenarioanalyses uitvoeren en de resultaten vertalen naar praktisch advies over winstgevendheid, facturatie en cashflow.

  • Project Managers ondersteunen bij projectopstart, maandelijkse reviews en projectafsluiting.

  • Zorgen voor een correcte projectopzet, coderingsstructuren en kostentoewijzingen.

  • Urenregistraties en projecttoewijzingen controleren op juistheid en consistentie.

  • Inefficiënties in projectuitvoering signaleren en bijdragen aan margeverbetering.

Financial Control

  • Verantwoordelijk voor de coördinatie en kwaliteitsbewaking van de financiële verslaggeving en de jaarrekening, inclusief relevante specificaties, balansdossiers en aansluitingen.

  • Verantwoordelijk voor de regie op de jaarlijkse accountantscontrole en de samenwerking met externe accountants, waarbij wordt gezorgd voor een efficiënte en succesvolle afronding van het controleproces.

  • Bewaken van de volledigheid en juistheid van financiële processen, interne beheersingsmaatregelen en financiële gegevens ter ondersteuning van een betrouwbare jaarafsluiting.

  • Signaleren van verbetermogelijkheden binnen financiële processen en bijdragen aan verdere professionalisering van de financiële organisatie.

  • Ondersteunen bij maand-, kwartaal- en jaarafsluitingen en zorgen voor betrouwbare financiële rapportages.

Business Control & Business Partnering

  • Bijdragen aan bedrijfsbrede budgettering, forecasting en lange termijn planning.

  • Helpen bij het opstellen van managementrapportages, KPI-dashboards en financiële analyses.

  • Projectresultaten verbinden aan de totale financiële prestaties van de organisatie.

  • Projectbudgetten afstemmen op bezetting en capaciteitsplanning.

  • Financiële data vertalen naar heldere, bruikbare adviezen voor niet-financiële collega's.

  • Management ondersteunen bij business cases, scenarioanalyses en besluitvorming.


Wie zoeken wij?

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Finance, Bedrijfseconomie, Accountancy of vergelijkbaar.

  • Minimaal 7 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen financial control, business control, accountancy of een vergelijkbare financiële functie.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met jaarafsluitingen, financiële verslaggeving en jaarrekeningen.

  • Ervaring met accountantscontroles en samenwerking met externe accountants.

  • Ervaring binnen een projectgedreven organisatie, bij voorkeur in architectuur, engineering, consultancy of een vergelijkbare omgeving.

  • Een sterk begrip van financiële rapportage, project accounting en interne beheersing.

  • Gevorderde Excel-vaardigheden en ervaring met ERP- en BI-tools.

  • Vloeiend Engels; Nederlands is een pré.

  • Analytisch, gestructureerd en kwaliteitsgericht.

  • In staat financiële vraagstukken begrijpelijk te maken voor niet-financiële stakeholders.

  • Proactief, zelfstandig en gericht op verbetering.



Wat bieden wij?

Bij MVRDV krijg je de kans om impact te maken binnen een internationaal, creatief en ondernemend bureau. Je werkt nauw samen met Project Managers, Directors en Financeteam van 5 collega’s en speelt een belangrijke rol in de verdere professionalisering van onze organisatie.

Wij bieden je:

  • Een uitdagende en afwisselende functie met veel verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte voor initiatief.

  • Een internationale werkomgeving met collega's en projecten over de hele wereld.

  • Volop mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling.

  • Een marktconform salaris conform de cao Architectenbureaus, passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring.

  • 30 vakantiedagen, hybride werken en een inspirerende werkplek in Rotterdam.

  • Onbeperkte toegang tot OpenUp, korting met Urban Sports, een gezonde lunch geserveerd, een NS Business Card en een laptop.

Klaar om mee te bouwen aan een financieel sterke toekomst voor MVRDV? We kijken uit naar je sollicitatie.

About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The opportunity: Full Stack Engineer

As a Full Stack Engineer, you will take primary ownership of our frontend experience while being capable of making the backend changes needed to unblock yourself and your team. You'll work closely with Backend Engineers, DevOps Engineers, and stakeholders to deliver scalable, reliable, and high-performance products end-to-end, from pixel to API.

Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam.

What you'll do in this role

  • Design, develop, and maintain frontend components in Angular (and Lit HTML where applicable), ensuring optimal performance, responsiveness, and usability.

  • Own the integration layer between frontend and backend: consume and contribute to OpenAPI-defined APIs, handle data contracts, and wire up microservices cleanly.

  • Make targeted backend changes, new endpoints, tweaks to existing services, minor data model updates, so you can ship features without always depending on a dedicated backend engineer.

  • Contribute to architectural discussions across the full stack, from UI component structure to API design and data access patterns.

  • Participate actively in code reviews, providing feedback on both frontend and backend code quality, adherence to standards, and performance.

  • Mentor and support junior engineers across the stack.

  • Stay current with evolving frontend and full-stack best practices.

What you bring to the table

  • 3+ years of experience in frontend or full stack engineering.

  • Strong proficiency in Angular and experience with component-based frameworks such as Lit HTML.

  • Solid understanding of responsive design, UX/UI principles, and a keen eye for design detail.

  • Proven experience integrating with APIs and microservices, you understand HTTP, REST conventions, auth flows, and error handling deeply.

  • Working proficiency in Python, enough to navigate a FastAPI codebase, add or adjust endpoints, and write Pydantic models and SQLAlchemy queries.

  • Familiarity with relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) at the query and schema level.

  • Experience with containerised workflows using Docker.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills; comfortable working independently and collaboratively.

  • Strong English communication skills and ability to work across disciplines.

  • Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily workflow.

  • Familiarity with LLM API integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) and an understanding of the UX patterns specific to AI-powered features.

What success in the first 6 months looks like

  • You've built trust with Backend, DevOps, and Product peers and taken clear ownership of 2–3 frontend domains, including their design system consistency and API integration contracts.

  • You've delivered frontend features end-to-end, from UX design discussion through Angular implementation, API wiring, tests, and documentation, without needing hand-holding at either layer.

  • You've unblocked yourself (and others) by making safe, well-reviewed backend changes: adding an endpoint, adjusting a response model, or optimising a query, rather than waiting in a queue.

  • You've raised frontend quality: responsive across devices, accessible, consistent with our design system, and validated against real API contracts rather than mocks.

  • You've contributed to meaningful observability on the frontend, error tracking, performance budgets, and linked them to backend SLIs where relevant.

  • You've shared knowledge through documentation, code reviews, and mentoring, so the team's frontend capability grows with you.

Current tech stack

We're fully cloud-native on AWS, with a lean, API-first product development approach.

Frontend: Angular · Lit HTML · Headless Wagtail · WordPress

Backend: Python · FastAPI · Pydantic · SQLAlchemy · MySQL · Neo4j

Platform: AWS · Kubernetes · Terraform · Docker · GitHub Actions · ruff · UV · pre-commit · Renovate

Our platform runs on Kubernetes-managed services and Terraform for infrastructure as code. We continue expanding capabilities in knowledge graphs (Neo4j) and modern data access patterns.

What we offer:

  • Impactful work that helps patients gain access to potentially lifesaving treatments. 

  • International work environment, scale-up energy and a flat organizational structure that encourages creativity and accountability. 

  • Competitive salary, annual performance bonus and an Employee Stock Option Plan. 

  • Great career development opportunities in a fast-growing company.  

  • Learning and development budget alongside internal knowledge sharing sessions. 

  • Attractive pension plan, full premium covered by myTomorrows. 

  • Hybrid working model. 

  • Policies to support working parents. 

  • Healthy lunch at the thriving Amsterdam office.  

  • Unlimited access to professional guidance by certified psychologists via OpenUp  

  • Enjoy monthly events hosted by our vibrant Culture Club as well as an annual ‘myTomorrowland’ company-wide celebration! 

Equal opportunities

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

About DataSnipper

Audit is the bedrock of the global economy. DataSnipper builds the AI that auditors and finance teams rely on to do that work with confidence: agents designed around how audits are actually performed, a platform firms trust with their most sensitive client evidence, and a team built around former auditors who know the work firsthand. We want to define how the profession works in the age of AI.

More than 600,000 professionals across 175 countries use DataSnipper, including all Big Four firms, Fortune 500 companies, and government agencies. In 2025 alone, we delivered over $1.4 billion in productivity savings for our customers. Backed by Index Ventures and Insight Partners, we are one of the fastest-growing companies in AI for audit, and the fastest-growing tech company in the Netherlands two years running.

Everything we build starts from one principle: AI in audit has to be something professionals can trust, verify, and defend. Joining now means helping lead the profession's shift from manual testing to agentic execution.


The Role


Partnerships are one of DataSnipper's most important growth levers. Across every major market, the consulting firms, technology platforms, and professional networks that organizations rely on shape which technologies their teams and clients adopt. As AI changes how audit work gets done, those partners are deciding who to build with.

As Strategic Partnerships Lead, you will lead, build, and launch DataSnipper's partnerships across Europe and the wider EMEA region, spanning our consulting alliances, key technology partners, and strategic relationships across the audit ecosystem and beyond. Our European ecosystem already includes relationships with leading consulting firms and regional networks. Your job is to scale it, and to build what comes next: new partner programs, new markets, and new commercial models.

This is an entrepreneurial, quota-carrying role with a broad remit and room to build. You will report to the Global Partnerships Leader and work closely with our EMEA Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Marketing teams.


What You Will Work On

About the role

Every customer's path through DataSnipper, from first sign-up to first agent run to renewal, runs on systems your team owns. We are hiring an Engineering Manager in our Amsterdam office to lead Billing & Monetization: how customers get in, what they are entitled to, and how AI usage turns into revenue.

Why DataSnipper?

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empowers those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.


For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output must be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand-new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

The Scope

  • Onboarding & offboarding: sign-up, trials, tenant and workspace provisioning, and the first-run experience. Getting a new firm from contract to value, fast.

  • Grow the scope. Expand ownership and stand up new teams as the area grows.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years leading engineering teams, on top of 5+ years as a software engineer

  • Experience building billing, licensing, entitlement or onboarding systems at scale, ideally usage- or credit-based

  • Strong fundamentals in software architecture, distributed systems, APIs and cloud-native development

  • Strong product aptitude: you challenge framing, make roadmap trade-offs, and care about activation and conversion as much as uptime

Getting equipment to and from an event, on time and in one piece, is one of the most critical things our customers do, and one of the hardest. Heavy, specialised, often fragile gear. Fixed vehicle and crew capacity. Round trips rather than one-way drops. Our customers solve this every week, mostly with spreadsheets, phone calls and hard-won instinct.

Transport is a priority on our roadmap, and we're bringing in dedicated ownership to make sure we deliver on it: how customers plan loads, sequence stops and optimise routes across their fleet. This role owns that outcome from the ground up. You'll start by getting close to customers to find the first slice of the problem they'll genuinely want to have solved, ship it, and build the roadmap from there.

Which features ship is yours to decide. You'll be shaping the domain and its roadmap, with the freedom to define how the product takes form. That's a rare amount of ownership for a PM, building something new from first principles, with real trust in how you get there.

What you'll do

  • Own Transport end to end: Running the full release train for your value stream: discovery, scoping, design, development, launch and post-launch tracking.

  • Run customer discovery yourself, in the field: Talk to rental companies about how they plan, staff and execute transport today: warehouse-to-venue routing, multi-stop and multi-vehicle loads, load order, crew and vehicle capacity, and the constraints that make equipment transport harder than generic delivery routing.

  • Define the first sellable increment. Find the smallest thing customers will genuinely pay for, ship it, and be able to explain why that slice was the right first bet.

  • Build and own a sequenced, evidence-based roadmap with the Head of Product, aligned to company goals and product strategy. And explain the prioritisation to sales, support and management so they can plan against it.

  • Translate routing and logistics complexity into buildable scope: multi-stop optimisation, time windows, vehicle and crew capacity, mapping and routing APIs, and the build-vs-buy decisions that come with them.

  • Remove every unnecessary obstacle between a new customer and their first successful project.
